newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Pan Andean ends BHP JV in Bolivia.
newsitem.headline: Pan Andean ends BHP JV in Bolivia.

text.p: Irish exploration group Pan Andean Plc said on Wednesday that it had agreed with Australia's Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd to terminate their joint venture in Bolivia.
Pan Andean said in a statement that this would result in 100 percent of the block reverting back to Pan Andean.
"Potential partners interested in participating in the further exploration and development of the Chapare block have already been contacted," Pan Andean said.
"Discussions on a joint venture with these major multinational oil companies will commence later this week."
Pan Andean said it remained totally committed to Bolivia and to the Chapare venture.
